description: This file contains kernel package definitions for multiple Linux kernel modules related to the Atmel AT91 platform. It specifies configurations, dependencies, files, and auto-loading instructions for components such as MMC/SD support, PWM, ADC, USB device controllers, and I2C.

classes.name: KernelPackage/mmc-at91
classes.description: Defines kernel package for MMC/SD Card support on AT91.

classes.name: KernelPackage/pwm-atmel
classes.description: Defines kernel module for PWM on ATMEL SoC.

classes.name: KernelPackage/at91-adc
classes.description: Defines kernel module for ADC on ATMEL SoC.

classes.name: KernelPackage/at91-udc
classes.description: Defines kernel module for USB Device Controller on AT91.

classes.name: KernelPackage/atmel-usba-udc
classes.description: Defines kernel module for High-speed USB Device Controller on ATMEL SoC.

classes.name: KernelPackage/at91-i2c
classes.description: Defines kernel module for I2C (TWI) master driver on AT91.

methods.name: call AutoLoad
methods.description: Auto-loading mechanism for kernel modules based on configuration and device tree.
